text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
“—Yeah. If I listen closely with these ears,
I can hear it anytime, damn it.”

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Piercing the heavens, shaking the earth,
setting my heart ablaze—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —This stylish, spirited festival music!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, step right up!
You there, and you over there!
Stop and listen up!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Born and raised downtown!
The stylish Ohi-born Umamusume!
A true-blue Edokko, Inari One, that's who I am!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What will be told now is a tale of stormy drama!
The brawl of a lifetime!
The grand festival of the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Until the very, very end—
keep your peepers peeled and watch me!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Today, my journey in the Twinkle Series
with Inari One truly begins...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The races run by Umamusume
are broadly categorized into two main divisions,
depending on the governing organization.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One is the Twinkle Series overseen by the URA.
Commonly referred to as the "Center."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the other is races overseen by
the "National Association of Regional Umamusume,"
commonly known as the NAU.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Held at racecourses like Oi, Kasamatsu, and Funabashi, focusing mainly on dirt races, these are known as the "NAR" (Regional) in contrast to the "JRA" (Central).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Inari One was originally an Umamusume meant to debut in the local leagues on a team in Ohi, not in the Central leagues.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, captivated by Inari One's running, I kept reaching out hoping to scout her, and over time she too began to feel the allure of the central races—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with the support of the locals,
Inari One transferred to Tracen Academy
and signed a contract with me as her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I must live up to Inari One, who believed in me and transferred here, and to the feelings of the local folks who sent her off...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With renewed determination, I headed toward the training course, only to find—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Ora ora ora ora oraaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beneath the clear blue sky, Inari One's spirited voice
echoes across the training track—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Lady Inari is in peak condition again today, alright!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A run that makes the heart pound—
as if slamming her wild, sharp, and bared fighting spirit
straight into the earth—
choice_data_list: (It's amazing every time I see it...!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Tracen Academy's track is in tip-top shape today too.
Man, I'm seriously grateful!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Whoops, if it ain't Boss!
What's up? How long've you been there?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Whoops, if it ain't Big Sis!
What's up? How long've you been there?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, no need to apologize.
I just got here a bit early to warm up
before you got here, Boss.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, no need to apologize.
I just got here a bit early to warm up
before you got here, Sis.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
“—After all, it's finally starting.
The grand, glorious path of Lady Inari
challenging the Twinkle Series!”

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ghh~~! 
I can't wait to run in the race! 
I wanna set off some massive fireworks real soon!
choice_data_list: First, let's do our best in the debut race!
First, let's do our best in the debut race!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah!
Train me hard, alright?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, they're sure staring
a whole lot again today."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
There's a bunch of folks watching me, y'see.
Ever since I started running, it's always been like that.
Look over there, towards the stands—

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm. So that's the rumored transfer student.
She seems pretty capable... but isn't she a bit rough around the edges?

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Their running style really is different on the regional circuit, huh?
I heard that girl from Kasamatsu
has a really unique form too—

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
It'll be quite a sight to see how far they can go.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
“—Most likely, it's just the usual business
of sizing up the new transfer student to see what she's made of.”

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The stares are a wee bit ticklish, but nothin' worth worryin' about.
After all, transfer students are rare at this academy, that's for sure.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Folks on the sidelines can yap all they want—
Once Lady Inari shows 'em her running in the race,
they'll shut up on their own!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her dignified bearing has remained completely unchanged ever since she transferred here. As her Trainer, I feel I must follow her example...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
――Alright!
Let's pick ourselves up and get to it.
What are we starting with today?
choice_data_list: First, how about we set our future goals?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
A goal, huh?
I can't really give ya anything specific, but...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
“—The grandest stage of the Twinkle Series.
I wanna throw the ultimate festival right there.”

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"And on top of that, I wanna stand right at the center of that festival
and make a grand declaration!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Something like, ‘Here stands Inari One,
the true-born Edokko Umamusume raised by Oi!!’
Just like that!"
choice_data_list: That's so like you, Inari. A fine goal.
That's so like you, Inari. What a great goal!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, you think so?
As expected of the Boss, always quick on the uptake.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, you think so?
As expected of the Sis, always quick on the uptake.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Alrighty, now that we've checked our goals,
let's hurry up and get training!
My body's just itchin' to move!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, after boosting our motivation, I began training with Inari One—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whew~! Worked up a great sweat!
The bath's gonna feel amazing today!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Good work today, Boss!
Let's keep this momentum going tomorrow—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Good work today, Big Sis!
Let's keep this momentum going tomorrow—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: —Inari-cha~n!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Good work~.
You seemed even more fired up than usual today♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Just like Creek said,
it was a really powerful run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The ones who called out to Inari One were two Umamusume who were destined to become her classmates...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One of them is Super Creek. Regarded as having exceptional stamina and race management, she is an Umamusume full of great potential...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The other is Oguri Cap. Like Inari One, she transferred from the regional circuit, and she's been steadily drawing attention with her extraordinary talent.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Heheh. Looks like you folks have been
workin' up quite a storm too.
I can tell just by lookin' at your faces and gear.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪
Watching how hard Inari-chan's working
made me feel like I can't afford to lose either~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: "Because we might end up being classmates running in the very same race."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I came to this academy from Kasamatsu myself,
so seeing Inari, a fellow transfer from the regional circuit, working so hard makes me really happy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But...
if we meet in a race, I will win.
I have no intention of losing.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heh, alright, alright!
You've got some real nerve picking a fight right off the bat!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'm lookin' forward to it too.
The day we can throw a wild, flashy festival together with you folks!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
See you again—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Pardon me~♪

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Man, I can't afford to lose.
You're the one who got me all fired up—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, Oguri Cap and Super Creek were the very two whose running Inari One watched when she first arrived at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I felt that those two would continue to be great rivals who would inspire Inari One in many ways going forward...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa there!
I almost forgot!
Boss, got a sec after this?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa there!
I almost forgot!
Big Sis, got a sec after this?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Alright, now it's finished.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After training, Inari One changed and brought
several tatami mats into the Trainer's office,
laying them out like a little island.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
My bad, Boss. I just can't seem to
settle down without this thing on me.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
My bad, Boss Lady. I just can't seem to
settle down without this thing on me.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Since I'll be working with ya in this room for
a good long while... I'm gonna borrow
this spot right here, if ya don't mind!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well then, might as well seal the bond with a drink while we're at it!
I'll go brew us some hot tea.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well then, once again...
I'm counting on you from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sitting together on the tatami mats,
we raise our teacups filled with hot tea
and pledge our path forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, my days of taking on challenges alongside Inari One began...!
